title: Make blunder audit web bind address explicit and configurable
description:
The broad blunder-audit path/file hardening work intentionally left `scripts/analysis/blunder_audit_web.py` bound to `0.0.0.0` because remote direct access from another machine is part of the current dev-server workflow. That means the remaining network-exposure question is now a focused product/configuration issue instead of an accidental side effect.

Current state:
- `blunder_audit_web.py` still binds the standalone audit server to all interfaces.
- This is intentional for at least one real workflow (SSH into a dev server, then browse `http://devserver:PORT/` from another machine without port forwarding).
- The threat model and scanner story are still unclear: CodeQL and human reviewers will continue to read this as an exposure unless the behavior is either configurable, documented, or explicitly justified.

Suggested scope:
- Add an explicit bind-host option/config for the audit web server instead of treating `0.0.0.0` as an undocumented constant.
- Decide whether the default should remain `0.0.0.0` for convenience or switch to loopback with a documented opt-in for remote access.
- Document the intended remote-access workflow and required network assumptions if all-interface binding remains supported.
- Either implement the chosen behavior or dismiss the remaining scanner alert with a concise threat-model note.
